scope.summary: Provide the color-management/prepress surface as one deduped set (this MT owns soft-proof; MT-250..MT-256 deepen the rest). Soft-proof: simulate a chosen output condition on screen using a device StudioColorProfile and a rendering intent WITHOUT converting document values, toggleable on/off, and MUST include color-blindness simulation profiles as proof conditions. The proof state is inspectable via Argus per [STU-COL-OBLIG-001] (PS/AI/ID proof setup + proof colors, deduped). Operator proof controls + model command.
acceptance_criteria: soft-proof by device profile+intent without converting values; color-blindness sim; Argus-inspectable state
expected_tests: live: soft-proof simulates device profile + intent on screen WITHOUT changing document values; toggle on/off
argus: color-blindness proof condition + proof state inspectable

risk_if_missed: No soft-proof; output preview + accessibility simulation unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
